name: UC Berkeley · Blackwell Hall double
derivedFrom: scaled from plan using the 80" length of the twin XL bed (cross-check: door clear opening scales to 34")

finishes.evidence: Official Blackwell room photo shows wood-look plank flooring, smooth painted walls, and an exposed concrete ceiling slab with surface conduit and a ceiling fan (https://housing.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/Blackwell-Room1-750px-700x500.jpg). Note the general furnishings page says 'Most rooms are carpeted' — the Blackwell photo contradicts that for this hall.

confidence: medium — a real architectural plan of the typical Blackwell double, but with no printed dimensions; all lengths are scaled from the 80" bed (door width agrees). Ceiling height is assumed and chair footprints are rounded from 5-star-base glyphs.
notes: Official text: door swings in and faces a window centred on the opposite wall; left wall has two XL twin beds with the Microchill fridge/microwave between them; right wall alternates closet, desk, closet, desk. Beds have dashed under-bed drawers. Closets show a dashed shelf/rod line. A narrow ~8"x24" element (pilaster/chase or shelf) sits in the SW corner beside the west closet and is not modelled. Scaled room ~17.9' x 10.4' (~186 sq ft); Blackwell advertises larger-than-standard rooms. Blackwell is a residence hall used by first-years but is the premium option; the classic Units 1-3 doubles only have a 250px 3D render (units-double_top-250px.jpg kept for reference).
